name: Ring of Summoning Affinity (Inevitable)
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 219
Aura faint conjuration [law] CL 5th
Slot ring; Price 8,100 gp; Weight —
Description
This ring resembles a gear or cog. If the wearer can cast summon monster spells, the wearer adds arbiterB2 to the 3rd-level list of monsters she can summon with those spells, adds zelekhutB2 to the 7th-level list, adds kolyarutB2 to the 8th-level list, and adds marutB2 to the 9th-level list. Also, once per day on command the wearer can use this ring to summon an arbiter, as if by the summon monster III spell.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, planar ally or planar binding, creator must be lawful neutral; Cost 4,050 gp
